recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Date Bark
steps: Split the dates open and press them flat, side by side, on a parchment-lined tray. Cover with another sheet of parchment and press into one even layer.
Spread or drizzle the peanut butter over the dates and scatter with chopped peanuts.
Pour the melted dark chocolate over the top, spread it to the edges, and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Freeze until firm, then break or cut into pieces. Keep in the freezer.
recipes.notes: Three ingredients (dates, peanut butter, dark chocolate) as named in the video — amounts weren't shown, so quantities and macros are estimates.
